premises: Microstructural descriptors (precipitate size/distribution, phase fraction, lattice distortions) can be rapidly quantified from as-cast HfNbTiVAl10.
These descriptors mediate dislocation motion and stress distribution, controlling elasticity, yielding, and fracture.
A machine learning surrogate model can capture these structure-property links.
The surrogate model will predict properties within ~10% of experiments.
